Position Overview:
The System Librarian ensures the reliability, functionality, and long-term sustainability of the library’s technical and archival infrastructure, enabling the university community to efficiently access, preserve, and engage with both current and historical resources. The position exists to manage and optimize the integrated library system (ILS), discovery platform, authentication and access tools, digital repository and archive systems (e.g., Archivematica and AtoM), and other technology platforms essential for resource management, long-term digital preservation, and institutional memory. Its scope encompasses systems administration, data integrity, interoperability across campus platforms, user-experience optimization, digital preservation workflows, and collaborations with IT and external partners. In addition, the librarian provides instruction and training for faculty, students, and staff on system use, digital preservation practices, and technology-enhanced research workflows. The key objective is to maintain a stable, secure, and user-centered systems and archival environment that supports teaching, learning, research, and long-term preservation, while advancing the library’s digital capabilities through strategic planning, technical stewardship, and continuous system enhancement.

Reports to:
University Librarian

1.	Serve as the chief liaison in technology matters, such as hardware and networking to campus IT, DUL, and outside IT service providers, represent the library in collaborative and cooperative technology efforts. 
2.	Troubleshoot problems and promptly report issues/unresolved problems to DUL IT, campus IT, and/or vendors with follow-through until resolution. 
3.	Maintain, support core library systems used for collection management, access, archives and special collections, the institutional repository, and related services, including Alma/Summon, Archivematica/AtoM, RFID services, and access control/security gate systems.
4.	Provide technical documentation and brief training to internal staff when system or workflow changes occur.
5.	Provide research and input on new technology systems, software, and equipment to enhance the operation and services of the library. 
6.	Select, install, maintain, and support library hardware, software and equipment. 
7.	Support developing and implementing strategies for storage and long-term preservation of digital collections by working with other relevant library staff.

9.	Contribute to library committees, institutional service, or professional organizations to support the mission and visibility of DKU Library.
10.	Participate in collaborative initiatives, cross-department projects, or working groups as needed.
11.	Facilitate and coordinate special library projects. 
12.	Compile statistics, analyze data, and prepare reports relating to areas of responsibilities. 
13.	Supervises staff, interns, and student assistants as needed to provide timely technical support. 
14.	Work toward achieving assigned annual objectives and KPIs, demonstrating accountability for performance and results.
15.	Perform other duties as assigned.
16.	University employees' job responsibilities will continue to expand in scope and depth as the University grows in size and complexity in its programs.

1.	Master’s degree from an ALA-accredited program or international equivalent in related fields or Information Systems, Computer Science with 2 years’ experience working in relevant fields in academic setting; or B.S. in Library and Information Science, Information Science, Computer Science and with at least 4 years’ IT experience working in academic setting.

At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Information about plant:
At our Changshu plant in China, we specialize in the manufacturing of essential products for dialysis therapy, including dialyzers, Sterile Solutions, bloodline sets, HD machines, injection and extrusion components. With a skilled team of 800 employees, our Plant operates key production technologies such as injection molding and extrusion, Dialysis and auto assembly etc. This site plays a vital role in Fresenius Medical Care’s commitment to enhancing patient care worldwide. Join our passionate team and be part of this global impact!

1) Main tasks:
Tasks performed regularly which form the essential characteristics of the position.

 ● Organization and execution of product verification of medical products, accessories, and modules.
 ● Ensure that product requirements are testable,
 ● Definition and coordination of test strategies
 ● Planning and organization of the system and software verification incl. Coordination with other departments, projects, and necessary resources
 ● Creation of test specifications, test cases and test activities according to the requirements of modules/products.
 ● Definition and creation of test set-ups, test tool and fixture development as required,
 ● Execution of system and software verification to ensure that the design input has been achieved.

 ● Follow processes to do peer reviews of test specification, test design and test cases.
 ● Creation of associated verification documents acc. to internal and external requirements and ensure them are audit-proof.

 ● Build up the knowledge network within verification team and other site teams in Verticals.
2) Secondary tasks:
Tasks performed regularly in addition to the main duties, but which do not determine the essential character of the position.

 ● Participate in all relevant process trainings and follow them in project work.
 ● Contribute to define test strategy, new concepts of HIL platform, and other automation technologies.
 ● Share good practices and ideas with team to improve tests.
 ● Participate in innovation activities and creations of solution for market needs.
 ● Understand the knowledge of dialysis products and basic principles of dialysis treatment
 ● 
3) Miscellaneous tasks:
Tasks not performed regularly which are nevertheless a distinct part of the job, or special tasks / project work.
• Other tasks assigned by superior leader

Qualifications, experience, know-how and skills critical for success*
1) Required training and education:

 ● Bachelor’s degree or above in computer science, mathematics, automation, information, or electronic engineering
2) Required professional experience (in years):

 ● 5 years or more related experience Prefer Medical Device industry
3) Important personal qualities:

 ● Enthusiastic on technical topics and be a quick learner to new things.
 ● Proactive, flexible and teamwork spirit
 ● Good communication skills
4) Other specialized knowledge:
a) Technical knowledge
Mandatory skills and knowledge:

 ● Understanding of quality process and common test methodologies.
 ● Solid experience working with python, shell scripts, Familiar with OOP Mith either C#, Java or C++.
 ● Experience working in Linux environment.
 ● Experience working Mith communication protocols (e.g. RS232, CAN, LANI etc.) is plus.
 ● Experience with software automation test framework design and development, and pure software automation testing skills,
 ● Familiar with Agile process (e.g. Scrum)
 ● Familiar with medical software development process and related quality processes.
 ● Familiar with continuous integration framework, e.g., Jenkins, DevOps.
 ● Familiar with code repositories, e.g., Git, Subversion.
 ● Familiar with product life cycle tool. e.g., Polarion, JIRA, etc.
 ● Familiar with SOUP software validation process in medical devices.
Desired skills and knowledge:

 ● Know-how of configuration management concepts, building framework design and architecture is plus.
 ● Experience with hardware involved automation testing design and development, experience with modulation simulation like Matlab is plus.
 ● Good knowledge of test specification with Mat lab/Simulink or Lab view is plus.
 ● Knowledge and experience of internet security technologies is plus,
 ● Knowledge and experience of Cybersecurity related document for medical devices registration is plus,
b) Languages

 ● Good Mandarin and English skills in writing and speaking
c) IT skills

 ● Have excellent skills with general computer use and office applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power point.
d) Product knowledge

 ● Familiar with medical device industry and knowledge of HD dialysis machine is preferred
5) Special personal requirements:

 ● Have strong sense of quality and responsibilities.
